row:
Join me on my journey as a proud patriot, aspiring horsewoman, and future equine massage therapist. 🇺🇸🐴
I'm sharing my love for horses, healthy living, and fitness. Expect to find me trying out new exercises, sharing my 30 Day Fit Girl Fall - Horse Girl Edition Vlog, and whipping up delicious and nutritious recipes. As I work towards becoming a certified equine massage therapist, I'll also be sharing my insights and experiences.
Oh, and don't expect my outfits to match! Let's connect, have some fun, and grow together. 🐎
